title: American Greed
description:
S15 E19 — Follow the Juul Money
When an epidemic of teenage nicotine addiction breaks out across the country, some people ask whether Juul's founders are intent on saving lives or targeting the next generation.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E18 — Fraud Collectors
Memorabilia legend Bill Mastro helps turn a childhood hobby into a billion-dollar business and rigs bids to scam collectors and sellers.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E8 — Extreme Home Ripoffs; Greedings From Florida
Two scheming brothers use a home remodeling business to rip off millions of dollars from Chicago homeowners; a scam artist tricks Florida retirees into investing in fake New York real estate.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Sucker Punch
After an inmate is assaulted, the jail identifies a suspect, but the violence doesn't stop there; a young inmate gets a crash course on how to survive in jail, as he prepares to deal with the consequences of his actions.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — We Fight
Indiana's Wabash Valley Correctional Facility is an isolated fortress with three officers for every 200 inmates; some inmates find themselves in racial conflict, while others seek conflict elsewhere.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Da Future
With over 2,000 inmates, the Wabash Valley Correctional Facility has a larger population and more acreage than the small town in which it's located; after a decade in confinement, one of Indiana's most infamous inmates moves to general population.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Father Figure
The killer of a corrections officer fights to be freed from 16 years of solitary confinement, and boyhood friends struggle to parent their kids from behind prison walls; but one, cut-off from visits with his son, is on a razor's edge.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Outlaws and In-Laws
Five miles from the riverfront hotels and restaurants of Savannah, Georgia, is a more ominous site, a place where an inmate is severely injured, and a friendship is torn; two soon to be brothers-in-law are accused of double homicide.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wis-Dumb
A planned romantic weekend turns into a nightmare for one young couple; a fight sends two women to segregation, and for one of the combatants, the isolation takes its toll.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Message in a Bottle
A jailhouse assault leads to one bloody inmate, and two sides to the story; another inmate makes a daring escape; one of the jail's most violent inmates decides it's time for a change.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Blue Balloons
A young couple comes to jail after a crime spree, but their stories don't add up; one of the jail's most prolific contraband smugglers makes her return, but staff cracks down on the pipeline.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Get Out and Stay Out
For some inmates, the only way out of prison is "paroling legit," or leaving in a body bag; others earn a lump sum of good time by completing programs or holding a prison job, while a few will take any chance to try to escape.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The Eyes Have It
Just weeks away from completing his sentence, an inmate is accused of murdering his cellie; a large woman with a personality to match loses everything to meth; an inmate causes a disturbance on the jail's transfer bus.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Fallen Leaf
An inmate finds himself at the center of more than one battle, and he traces his problems back to the real-life nightmare that haunts his family; a young new arrival faces a charge of reckless homicide.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Suicide Watch
An agitated inmate takes severe measures to get staff's attention; a young first-timer is found unconscious in his cell; another inmate garners "enemy status" within the jail.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Mail, Nails, Jail
The jail's Special Operations Group is called in to deal with a difficult inmate; a well-known inmate returns to jail, but this time, he's in with his girlfriend, who might be harboring a secret that could dramatically affect both their lives.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Two Degrees of Murder
A pregnant woman faces the charge of killing her husband two months away from giving birth; her future lies in the hands of a judge; another inmate, also facing a murder charge, pays a price when he disobeys orders.

title: Lockup: Boston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Baptism by Fire
Inside Suffolk County Jail, one inmate finds himself on the wrong end of a vicious attack; another, with a reputation for violence, keeps the staff on constant alert; a young man with a bright future awaits trial for first-degree murder.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — The Shakedown
Correctional officers are outnumbered 10 to 1 and are constantly searching over 1,000 inmates to find their home-made weapons, which are very easy to conceal; hours after the Lock-Up crew wraps shooting, an inmate is stabbed in the honor dorm.
